overview: Spain is a country in south-western Europe, covering most of the Iberian Peninsula. Its capital and largest city is Madrid. In the 1500s Spain built a huge empire in the Americas, which is why Spanish is now one of the most widely spoken languages in the world. Spain returned to democracy after the death of the dictator Francisco Franco in 1975, and it joined what is now the European Union in 1986.

geography.text: Much of Spain is a high central plateau called the Meseta, ringed by mountains such as the Pyrenees on the French border and the Sierra Nevada in the south. Spain has coastlines on both the Atlantic and the Mediterranean. Its territory also includes the Balearic Islands, the Canary Islands off north-west Africa, and the cities of Ceuta and Melilla on the north coast of Africa.
